pages.title: Frederick C. Robie House
pages.tagline: A measured survey of a Prairie School house

pages.title: Every line of the house runs with the street.
pages.text: A long, low house on a corner lot in Chicago's Hyde Park: two slipped rectangular volumes under broad hipped roofs, with the living and dining rooms raised to the second floor and opened to the street through a continuous band of art-glass doors. The roofs cantilever far beyond the walls and the brick is laid with raked horizontal joints.
pages.caption: Street view. Broad hipped roofs and long brick walls hold the corner lot.

pages.title: The second floor opens as one room.
pages.caption: Interior. The living and dining space on the second floor, lit through art-glass.

pages.title: The 1963 survey reads from plans to sections to elevations.
pages.text: Measured and drawn in 1963 by the Historic American Buildings Survey (Chicago Project, survey ILL-1005) under the National Park Service.

pages.title: Ground floor serves; the main floor is one space.
captions: First (ground) floor plan. Billiard room, playroom and garage; scale 1/8 inch to the foot.
Second (main) floor plan. Living and dining room divided only by the fireplace and stair.

pages.title: Bedrooms sit on the third floor, above the roofs.
pages.caption: Third floor plan. The third floor holds the bedrooms; a doorway was inserted between the master bedroom and the dressing room.

pages.title: The section shows the cantilevered roofs and the raised main floor.
pages.caption: Longitudinal section and south elevation. Both drawn at 1/8 inch to the foot.

pages.title: Three more elevations confirm the horizontal order.
pages.caption: West, east and north elevations. Brick with raked horizontal joints under hipped roofs.

pages.title: The fireplace and windows are drawn at larger scale.
captions: Fireplace elevations. East and west faces at 3/8 inch to the foot.
Robie House windows. First floor pattern and second floor window details.

pages.title: Art glass is documented pane by pane.
pages.text: Sheets by Robert C. Giebner and Janis J. Erins. Scale 1/8 inch to the foot for plans, sections and elevations; 3/8 inch for the fireplace elevations.
pages.caption: Second (main) floor windows. Art-glass panels in detail.

pages.statement: Study of a measured survey. Individual work, 6 weeks.
